history.content: Hi, my phone has no signal at all today. Nothing loads, I can't send picture messages, and it's just dead as far as the internet goes. It was working fine yesterday.

I can help you with this issue. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide either your phone number, customer ID, or your full name and date of birth? This will allow me to check your line status and assist you further.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you for the information. Your line status is currently Active, so there are no suspensions or contract issues.

Let’s troubleshoot your no signal and connectivity problem step by step. Could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know if you see any icons such as Airplane Mode, signal bars, or any error messages? This will help determine if the issue is with your device settings or the network.
I see a 'No Signal' icon in the status bar. Data is enabled, and it says I'm connected to Chestnut-5G WiFi, but there are no signal bars showing at all.

Thank you for checking. Since you see a "No Signal" icon and no signal bars, this suggests your phone is not connecting to the cellular network at all, even though WiFi is working.

Let’s try the following steps to resolve this:

1. Check if Airplane Mode is ON. If it is, please turn it OFF.
2. If Airplane Mode is OFF, the next step is to check your SIM card. Please reseat your SIM card by removing it and reinserting it, or use the “Reseat SIM Card” option if your phone provides it.

Can you confirm if Airplane Mode is OFF? If it is, please proceed to reseat your SIM card and let me know if you see any change in your signal.
I reseated the SIM card, but I got a message saying the SIM is still locked. There was no change in the signal.
YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.

arguments.summary: Customer Sofia Martinez has no cellular signal. After troubleshooting, the SIM card is reported as locked and requires unlocking (PIN/PUK). Needs human agent assistance to unlock SIM.
